observations: I opened assets/panels/02-3.png and main-cast.png with Read. Meera stands beside the wooden desk and matches her sheet: round bright eyes, high arched brows, round face, braid over her left shoulder (screen-right) with a teal tie, blue block-print kurta, white churidar, silver bangle.

The hands match production. Her right hand (screen-left, bangle on that wrist) holds the staff phone up at upper-chest height with the screen toward the reader. Her left hand hangs relaxed and empty by the chair. The grip on the phone is clean.
The phone screen shows only a teal bar, a simple calendar icon and two coloured blocks. The open laptop shows blank rounded fields and blocks. Neither has text or data.
The set matches the scene: pen cup and potted plant on the desk, an empty black office chair beside her, a window with a roller blind and evening sky at right. This is the same office as 02-2.
Acting: she looks up with an open, bright smile, which reads as relieved and excited. The large empty wall above leaves room for the balloon and label.
Limitation: I did not open the source text or page-02.svg.
